description: Free vehicle history check against the official Czech vehicle registry (Registr silničních vozidel) by 17-character VIN: owner count and ownership timeline (companies named with IČO, private persons anonymous), STK inspection history with results, the odometer reading at every STK inspection since 2008 (`odometer`: readings, last km and date, `rollback` when a later visit reads lower; from the Ministry of Transport open inspection data, about three weeks behind), import origin, deregistration episodes, seized-document flags and technical specs. There is NO license-plate lookup. Unknown VINs fall back to a rate-limited live registry lookup without timelines.
name: check_vehicle_by_vin
